lines: Daring and fearless, a modern-age revolution
Open and carefree, a nation against war
Rolling along a two-wheeler marked with the rising sun
Evil spirits, begone — ICBM
Racing through the loop line
Running every which way — so what
Boys and girls, unmatched in the warring states
Drifting with this floating world
A thousand cherry trees, slipping into the night
Even your voice can't reach me
Here is a banquet, a cage of steel
Look down from that guillotine
Three thousand worlds, the darkness of the eternal realm
Even the mourning song can't be heard
The azure sky, far far away
Shoot it through with that ray gun

That one and this one, everyone gather round
